brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: 4x full bases forming 2 columns (0,0,0 / 1,0,0) stacked to level 1 (0,0,1 / 1,0,1) with snaps snap:0,0,0;full snap:1,0,0;full and jointBolts jointBolt:0#0,0#0 jointBolt:1#0,0#0; meshClash clear

4 notch drawer frames: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (L0), notch:1#0,1#notch1 (L1), notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (L0), notch:1#1,-1#notch4 (L1) - each is a pull-out drawer filling the gap between the two columns, so 4 drawers >2

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-column x 2-storey tower (0,0 and 1,0 stacked). Four notch drawer frames span the gaps at q0,1 and q1,-1 on both levels, providing 4 drawers. Structure verified meshClash clear, joined with snaps and joint bolts.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
